VDI::disable
       Disable VDI plugin.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       The VDI::disable command disables VDI plugin in the flow.

       Syntax

       VDI::disable

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       CLIENT_ACCEPTED, HTTP_REQUEST

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    VDI::disable
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.4.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
